ctx.x:
This is Sunday, April 10, 1976.
I'm sitting here with a dear friend of mine, Quentin Jackson. We've known one another for many, many years.
And, Quentin, I just want to say that amongst all musicians you are considered, without any question of a doubt, one of the greatest instrumentalists in the terms of our craft as sidemen that ever existed in the history of orchestral and jazz playing. I don't think there's anybody that has come through or played in as many great bands, any instrumentalist or jazz musician, as…
I was born in Springfield, Ohio, January 13, 1909.
